independentDerivationAndChecks: Alive-after-h count is h+1-A(h); each live award>h and<=d(h), so d(h)-h>=h+1-A(h), giving E>=0. FFD and victim propagation supply r on every row h,..., r-1, in distinct surviving old hosts<h; there are h-A(h) of them, so F>=0.

Adding definitions cancels A and2h, leaving d(h)-r=1+E+F exactly. FFD gives d(h)>r. Since p blocker cannot equal a diagonal and d(h)<p=r+3, d(h)-r is1or2. Integer nonnegative E, F therefore have sum0or1, yielding exactly three pairs.

At E0 all live awards fill their available integer interval; old survivors fill[h+1, d(h)-1]. At F0 the r-host injection saturates the survivor roster. These are equality structures only; neither forces a private p booking or excludes gap four.
